## Headline

**Dr Stephen J Newhouse, PhD** — Senior data scientist / bioinformatician.
Translational genomics · ML for health · agentic AI.
Based in the UK · open to remote.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sjnewhouse/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/snewhouse) · [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/sjnewhouse) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1843-9842) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=NPnNtkMAAAAJ)

## Skills

- **Languages:** Python, R, Bash, SQL; some Rust / Go
- **ML / data:** scikit-learn, PyTorch, HuggingFace, pandas, polars; classical stats; survival; biostats
- **LLM / agents:** Claude / Anthropic, OpenAI, vLLM, retrieval, evaluation, MCP, agentic memory
- **Bioinformatics:** NGS (DNA/RNA), variant calling, GWAS, RNA-seq, multi-omics; Bioconductor
- **Pipelines:** Snakemake, Nextflow, CWL; Docker, Singularity; Conda
- **Cloud / infra:** AWS, GCP, Azure; Linux, HPC, SLURM; Terraform basics
- **Engineering practice:** Git/GitHub, CI/CD, code review, reproducible research, open source
